title: Geometric square-sum bound
statement: For every real number $\delta$ with $0<\delta\leq 1$ and every natural number $N$, the finite geometric sum satisfies $\sum_{k=0}^{N-1}(1-\delta)^{2k}\leq 1/\delta^2$.
